azimuth-evo.name: Azimuth Evo
azimuth-evo.description: The PFM AZIMUTH EVO is a full-servo vertical form fill seal wrapper that produces pillow pack bags and Steelo Bags (block bottom with 4 side sealed corners) starting from a flat reel of heat-sealable packaging material.

azimuth-evo-inclined-version.name: Azimuth Evo Inclined Version
azimuth-evo-inclined-version.description: The PFM AZIMUTH EVO Inclined is a full-servo vertical form fill seal wrapper that produces pillow pack bags and Steelo Bags (block bottom with 4 side sealed corners) it is designed for fragile and delicate products requiring controlled handling during vertical packaging.

bg-2800-4800.name: Bg 2800 4800
bg-2800-4800.description: Designed for High Speed packaging, in MAP as well, with completely air tight seals, compact, smooth, free from product wrinkles and of the highest quality for when the package appearance is of the highest importance.

blizzard-cut-flow-wrap.name: Blizzard Cut Flow Wrap
blizzard-cut-flow-wrap.description: Blizzard is the High Speed Pillow Pack packaging machine to make closed packs with three seals starting from a flat reel of hot or cold seal wrapping material.

blizzard-hard-candy.name: Blizzard Hard Candy
blizzard-hard-candy.description: The Blizzard Hard Candy is an horizontal flow pack wrapping machine to produce 3-seal packs starting from a reel of heat or cold-seal film.

bora.name: Bora
bora.description: Full servo horizontal wrapping machine to make pillow-pack bags from a flat reel of wrapping material.

comet.name: Comet
comet.description: The PFM COMET is a continuous motion vertical form fill seal machine designed for high-speed wrapping of granular products with hermetic sealing performance: chips/crisps, candies and many others combined with multihead weighers and volumetric dosing systems.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: The Compact is the revolutionary horizontal packing machine for producing triple-seal, square bottom and gusseted flow-packs.

falcon.name: Falcon
falcon.description: The PFM Falcon is a horizontal flow wrapper able to produce bags sealed on three sides from an open roll of hot or cold sealable material.

ghibli.name: Ghibli
ghibli.description: Flow wrapper designed to wrap large-sized food products, ensuring stability, control, and production continuity even in the most demanding applications.

levante.name: Levante
levante.description: The PFM Levante is a high-speed horizontal flow wrapper designed to produce pillow-pack bags from an open roll of hot or cold sealable material, combining speed, control and reliability for continuous, high-performance production.

mbp-c1-series.name: Mbp C1 Series
mbp-c1-series.description: Entry-level budget combination multi-head weigher, withoutstanding speed/accuracyratio.

mbp-c2-series.name: Mbp C2 Series
mbp-c2-series.description: 100% made in Italy, the Series C2 represents thevery best in high-tech multi-head weighers.

mbp-c3-series.name: Mbp C3 Series
mbp-c3-series.description: To achieve a precision of 0,1-0,8 grams on the weighing average, we reduced the mass and volume of the buckets to 1 lt and provided it with a single opening. The load cell is sized according to the range of the weight target, which is lower than in the C2. The C3 is available with 10-14-16-20-24-32 heads and their respective DMAs versions. It is the best choice also for mixed products, from 2 to 4 flavors.

mbp-c4-series.name: Mbp C4 Series
mbp-c4-series.description: MBP Multihead Weighers presents the new range of Series C4 multihead weighers, which are successfully launching the company into the high speed precision weighing sector for fragile and delicate products.

mistral-ba.name: Mistral Ba
mistral-ba.description: A flow-wrap packaging machine which produces packs sealed on three sides from a roll of heat-sealable packaging film, the Mistral is designed for high-speed MAP packaging.

mistral-bb.name: Mistral Bb
mistral-bb.description: Designed for high-speed MAP packaging, Mistral combines packaging speed with hermetic sealing.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.description: Full servo horizontal pillow-pack wrapper to obtain pillow-pack style packs from a flat reel of heat/cold sealable wrapping material.

polar.name: Polar
polar.description: The PFM POLAR is a vertical form fill seal machine specifically designed for dairy products and high-hygiene environments. It produces pillow packs and packs with clip from a reel of heat-sealable wrapping material.

pulsar.name: Pulsar
pulsar.description: Designed to wrap products of varying size and shape, thanks to the LVA feature, ensuring consistent packaging quality and smooth operation even with non-uniform formats.

pv320-high-speed.name: Pv320 High Speed
pv320-high-speed.description: The PFM PV320 High Speed is a continuous motion vertical form fill seal machine designed for high-speed wrapping og granular products with hermetic sealing performance.

r-700.name: R 700
r-700.description: The R700 is avertical form fill and seal packaging machinefor the production of bags sealed on three sides, such as pillow-bags, as well as block bottom bags and/or block bottom bags with 4 corner seals.

r-700-twin.name: R 700 Twin
r-700-twin.description: R-Series’ technology guarantees top performance and smaller overall dimensions. The TWIN configuration allows double production using one MBP multi-head weigher, even in small places.

rc-700.name: Rc 700
rc-700.description: RC700/800 is a continuous motion VFFS machine with Box-Motion top produce pillow bags, square bottom bags and Steelo Bags. RC700/800 is equipped with one or two reel-holder shafts and the sealing unit inside the calender for Pillow-Packs and Steelo-Bags.Speed: up to 180 Pillow Bags per minute and up to 100 Steelo Bags per minute.

rq-700.name: Rq 700
rq-700.description: Intermittent, Single-reel Vertical Form Fill Seal with removable sealing unit. Sealing pressure in kg adjustable from the monitor.

rx800.name: Rx800
rx800.description: The synthesis of operational simplicity, high productivity and very low running costs.

scirocco.name: Scirocco
scirocco.description: Scirocco is a flow-pack servo assisted horizontal wrapping machine for producing wraps hermetically sealed on three sides from a reel of heat-sealed wrapping material.

scirocco-combi.name: Scirocco Combi
scirocco-combi.description: Designed for advanced 3-side seal packaging, Scirocco Combi integrates reclosable solutions such as zip, folded hem or label, ensuring product protection, usability after opening and consistent packaging performance.

shamal.name: Shamal
shamal.description: Servo controlled horizontal flow wrapper that produces pillow packs with three air tight seals.

sirio.name: Sirio
sirio.description: The PFM Sirio is a full servo controlled machine specifically designed for the dairy sector, able to produce pillow bags while ensuring hygienic operation and reliable performance.

solaris-evo.name: Solaris Evo
solaris-evo.description: The Solaris EVO is th high speed continuous motion vertical form fill and seal wrapper that produces 3-side sealed pillow-bags, block-bottom and Steelo- bags, doy-style bags also with zip and eurohole.

tornado-ld.name: Tornado Ld
tornado-ld.description: The Tornado LD is a horizontal flowrapping machine that produces up to 100 packs/min with hermetic seals from a flat reel of heat seal wrapping material.

vetta.name: Vetta
vetta.description: The PFM VETTA is a vertical form fill seal system designed to produce a wide range of packaging formats within a single machine architecture. Vetta can offer up to 30 different bag styles, from standard vertical form fill and seal using clear or printed film, to stand-up oval bottom bags with sombrero hole punch.

zenith.name: Zenith
zenith.description: The PFM ZENITH is a vertical form fill seal machine designed for granular products (chips/crisps, candies and many others), combining dosing systems and wrapping into a stable and easy-to-manage process.

zephyr.name: Zephyr
zephyr.description: High speed wrapper designed with cantilevered main frame and vertical plate for complete separation product/drive elements to run on multi-shift operations.
